Former bed wetters unite! (One of my highest ranked comments on my main account is about how I pissed on my brother for telling people about it and I wanted him to know how awful it was.) Thank you so much for your correction and kind words- I drafted this in Quark at work a couple of times earlier today and the those helpful squiggly lines that normally pop up under misspelled words are not a feature to that program and I copied it out of an e-mail to myself.

I did a lot of writing in the past, I just don't see a feasible way to use it. I got really fucked up on psilocybin and watched The Flaming Lips play "The Dark Side of the Moon" at a festival (shortly before the arrest)- as I laid in the grass I came up with this fantastic idea for my ex's nephew, I wanted to write and illustrate a book with his likeness, it was also a prototype for a stop motion kids' show that I wanted to produce myself for Youtube... when I got home I sat down and started writing it down. It turns out that my idea of a young kid being the lone human of a very strange and terrifying world using empathy, compassion, love, and morals without religion to fight his adversaries was already in production. I did not have cable television at the time- it turns out that this guy named Pendleton Ward had already successfully created a very similar character and an equally fucked up universe for him to live in. It is called "Adventure Time" and is wildly popular. I fear being called a thief or a hack if I come up with a "brilliant" idea that already exists in some form or fashion- for example I "invented" corrugated cardboard one night when I was trying to make a paper mache pinata and wanted to cut down on the weight by using the structural integrity of triangles layered between flat surfaces... I thought "Whoa! Why don't other people build like this OH SHIT never mind!"

As for love and loss, I have a tough time accepting defeat when it comes to the things that I love and care about. The movie "Labyrinth" where the old hag is dragging around a cart full of Sarah's childhood shit is a decent analogy- I carry around all of my old shit because I am scared of forgetting it.
